posts.title: Composite Dark Matter, Part II: The Leftover Scalar Field
posts.description: When dark matter forms large composites, the binding energy has to go somewhere. In a secluded dark sector it goes into the light scalar field, which can leave a trace in the CMB.

posts.title: Composite Dark Matter, Part I: From Dark Atoms to Dark Nuggets
posts.description: Most of the matter we know is made of bound states. Could dark matter be too? From dark atoms up to very heavy dark nuggets, and how you would detect them.

posts.title: Furry's Theorem, Part 1: The Proof
posts.description: Proving Furry's theorem (correlation functions with an odd number of photon fields vanish) with the path integral and with Feynman diagrams.
